name: Fix timeline scrubber bug
notes: Fixed by: 1) Moving scrubber event listeners to init (registered once), 2) Using event delegation for track interactions so they survive DOM re-renders, 3) Always querying fresh DOM elements in yearFromPosition/updateScrubberVisual, 4) Adding detached element guard (width=0 returns currentYear). Root cause: stale track.getBoundingClientRect() on detached element returned {left:0,width:0}, making pct=Infinity which clamped to 1 = year 2025.

name: Fix history variable shadowing window.history
notes: Renamed local `history` array to `historyStack` to avoid shadowing `window.history`. Changed `history.replaceState` to `window.history.replaceState`. This fixed URL hash persistence which was silently failing.

name: Fix mobile horizontal overflow
notes: Added overflow: hidden to .nav-wrapper to prevent tab-scroll from causing horizontal page scroll on mobile (375px).
